text:
Asha Rao: FYI we're updating the press syndication policy for product benchmarks. New rule: no partner syndication before primary release time unless explicit written exception. Need ops + legal sign-off.
Ben Torres: Can you drop the exact clause? I want to pass to syndication partners.
Asha Rao: Clause: 'Partners may syndicate Redwood-owned benchmark content only at or after the official public release time published by Redwood Inference, except where a written exception signed by PR and Legal is provided.'
Kelsey Moore: From growth side this is fine — protects our impressions. We should add a short explanation for partners so they understand embargo reasoning.
LegalBot: Legal ok on clause but require an audit trail: partner email + signed waiver saved to /legal/waivers/bench-syndications. Also require partner acknowledgment checkbox on the syndication form.
OpsBot: Ops note: update CMS rules to set syndication meta flag and block republish queue until release timestamp. I can add an automated hold in the ingestion pipeline.
Ben Torres: I'll update the partner-facing doc and email template. Draft link will be in /PR/templates/syndication-update.md.
Asha Rao: Great. Can Legal fast-track a template waiver for analysts who need early access? We should avoid ad-hoc emails.
LegalBot: Will draft a short waiver and add to the waiver store. ETA 2 hours.
Kelsey Moore: Also propose we offer a limited preview bundle to approved analysts (watermarked PDF + time-limited link) — less risk than full syndication. Thoughts?
Asha Rao: Love that. Ops — can we generate expiring signed URLs?
OpsBot: Yes. Signed URLs with 48h TTL are supported. I'll stand up a small generator and log accesses to /logs/preview-access.
Ben Torres: Ok pushing the partner update at 18:00 UTC today. Will include the waiver link and explanation.
Asha Rao: Thanks team. Locking this as policy v1.0. If anything breaks, open a ticket in #marketing-ops.
notes: policy update for syndication, includes legal and ops actions
